music.prompt: Serene traditional Chinese solo guqin, unmetred gentle plucks with glassy harmonics and slow slides, a soft breathy xiao flute far away, pentatonic, peaceful and spacious, like a quiet garden at dawn

The same guqin turns dark: low muted string bends and a slow descending figure, a deep low drum roll swelling underneath, a cold low xiao drone, minor pentatonic, sorrowful and heavy, no melody resolution

Tender hopeful theme: guqin harmonics like small points of light, a warm low string pad entering slowly, a gentle xiao melody in a major pentatonic mode, slow and quiet, growing a little warmer toward the end, ending on a soft open chord
